sections.title: Colours with clothes
sections.content: You know an adjective goes in front of its noun, so a colour does too: *szürke szoknya* (a grey skirt), *fekete sapka* (a black hat). New: *szürke* (grey) and *színes* (colourful). You know *kék*, *fehér*, *fekete*, *barna*, *piros*, *zöld* and *sárga*. You know *Milyen a kabát?* from unit 25; answer with the colour alone: *Kék.*

items.english: What is your hat like? – Black.

items.spanish: Fehér ingem és barna cipőm van.
items.english: I have a white shirt and brown shoes.
There is a colourful jumper here.

sections.content: The colour never changes before a noun: *szürke szoknya* and also *szürke szoknyák*.
